decisions.reason: It closely fits the firm's push toward digital efficiency and energy-optimized infrastructure operations, so a recently launched automation module is likely to be developed further rather than withdrawn.

The web tool supports engineering planners and the firm's end-to-end solution approach, but as a lighter software tool outside the core installed-system business it has a somewhat higher rationalization risk than the other products.

A fouling detection system matches the firm's established integrated machinery-and-software offer and its focus on operational transparency, making retention more likely even if the portfolio is later streamlined around adjacent solutions.
